commentary.bulkers: Michele Bottiglieri Armatore have committed their Kamsarmax "MBA Liberty" 82/2010 Tsuneishi Zhoushan, China (SS 01/2025, DD 03/2023, BWTS fitted) for USD 22 mill. Remind you that back in December, the two- years-younger sister vessel "King Barley" 82/2012 Tsuneishi Zhoushan, China (basis SS/DD passed, BWTS fitted) was sold at USD 22,7 mill. Nisshin Shipping sold their Ultramax "Hanton Trader II" 63/2014 Jiangsu, China (SS 08/2024, DD 06/2022, BWTS fitted) to Hong Kong based buyers Jinhui for USD 25,5 mill, while the one-year-younger "Drogba" 63/2015 Chengxi, China (SS 10/2025, DD 07/2023, BWTS fitted) was sold for USD 28,7 mill. For reference, the sisters "Andros Island" 63/2016 Zheijiang, China (SS 01/2026, DD 01/2024) & "Syros Island" 63/2015 Zhejiang, China (SS 07/2025, DD 10/2023) were sold a couple of weeks ago at USD 25 mill each. On the Supramax sector, Pacific Carriers sold their "Atlantic Mexico" 56/2011 Taizhou, China (SS/DD 10/2023) for USD 17 mill. Note that a couple of weeks ago, the sister vessels "Mandarin Grace" & "Mandarin Trader" 56/2011 Jiangsu, China (SS 01/2026, DD 12/2023 & SS 07/2025, DD 05/2023 respectively, BWTS fitted both) were sold at USD 17,1 mill each. In addition, the two-years-younger "Nathan Brandon" 56/2013 Huatai, China (SS/DD 08/2023, BWTS fitted) was committed for USD 19 mill. Further to the sale of the "Atlantic Mexico", Pacific Carriers committed their Handysize "Atlantic Veracruz" 28/2009 Shimanami, Japan (SS/DD 07/2022) to Vietnamese buyers for low-mid USD 13 mill. For comparison, the one- year-younger sister vessel "Tramontana" 28/2010 Shimanami, Japan (SS 08/2025, DD 09/2023, BWTS fitted) was sold a month ago at USD 14,5 mill.
commentary.tankers: The VLCC sister vessels "Nautilus" 307/2006 Dalian, China (SS 12/2026, DD 02/2025, BWTS fitted) & "Navarin" 307/2007 Dalian, China (SS/DD 07/2022) of Ridgebury Tankers were sold to Korean buyers Sinokor for USD 63,5 mill enbloc. Note that back in January, the younger "New Talisman" 296/2009 Bohai, China (SS 09/2024, DD 09/2022, BWTS fitted) was sold at USD 36 mill. Teekay Corp have sold their Aframax "Axel Spirit" 115/2004 Samsung, Korea (SS 04/2024, DD 05/2022) to Chinese buyers for USD 13,2 mill. Moreover, the smaller "Bunga Kelana 10" 105/2004 Samsung, Korea (SS 09/2024, DD 10/2022) was committed to Singaporean buyers for low USD 12 mill, whilst the sister vessel "Bunga Kelana 9" 105/2004 Samsung, Korea (SS 08/2024, DD 08/2022) has gone to Indonesian buyers for low USD 12 mill also. The MR1 "Duke I" 40/2002 Hyundai Mipo, Korea (SS 09/2026, DD 12/2024) was sold to undisclosed buyers for USD 7,1 mill. The smaller but younger "Torm Tevere" 37/2005 Hyundai Mipo, Korea (SS 07/2025, DD 10/2023) from TORM was sold to Nigerian buyers for USD 8,3 mill.
